title: 2026.44: At Long Last…
author: Ben Thompson
description: The best Stratechery content from the week of October 26, 2026 including Anthropic numbers, the end of the Internet as we know it, and autocracies then and now.
summary: (Photo by Carmen Mandato/Getty Images) Welcome back to This Week in Stratechery! As a reminder, each week, every Friday, we’re sending out this overview of content in the Stratechery bundle; highlighted links are free for everyone .
takeaways: Fintechs can build entire business models around card programs without ever having to build the issuing and processing infrastructure underneath it.

Anthropic S-1, The Cost of Compute, Who Is Paying? — Anthropic’s IPO is finally here; the core business is very profitable, but competition may eat all of the profits, even as investors are set up for endless dilution.

An Interview with Palantir CTO Shyam Sankar About the AI Religious War — An interview with Palantir CTO Shyam Sankar about AI diffusion and safety, forward-deployed engineer, and what the battle in tech is actually about.
